CAUSE CALLED FOR JURY TRIAL. PL. PRESENT W/BRENDA CRUZ- KEITH AS COUNSEL. DEF. PRESENT W/JOSE CANAVERA AS SPANISH INTERP. & IN PRO PER. SETTLED BY STIP. W/JUDGMENT FOR PL. - RESTITUTION OF PREMISES AT 1270-A HAMPSHIRE, S.F, CA. - WRIT TO ISSUE IMMEDIATELY, BUT EVICTION STAYED TO 4-11-94, MIDNIGHT - KEYS TO BE RETURNED TO INTERP. - ALL RENT & DAM- AGES, COSTS & ATTY FEES WVD. - FORF. OF LEASE/RENTAL AGREE- MENT - IF DEF. VACATES BY 4-11-94, PL. WILL S/A JUDGMENT. PL. ATTY. TO PREPARE JUDGMENT.

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT FUENTE, RAFAEL THE RESTITUTION AND POSSESSION OF THE PREMISES: 1270-A HAMPSHIRE, S.F, CA., STAYED UNTIL APR-11-1994, LEASE FORFEITED, EACH SIDE TO BEAR THEIR FEES & COSTS. IF DEF. VACATES BEFORE MIDNIGHT 4-11-94, WITHIN 10DAYS THEREAFTER, PL. WILL MOVE THAT JUDGMENT BE VACATED. WRIT TO ISSUE IMMEDIATELY, BUT EVICTION STAYED TO 4-11-94 & RETURN KEYS TO SP. INTERP. SEE FIEL FOR COMPLETE JUDGMENT DETAILS.
